description: DII 100% cotton, machine washable, everyday kitchen dishtowels & dishcloths helps to make sure dishes and countertops are clean and dry. These are the perfect dishtowel for your daily kitchen tasks to hold up to tough kitchen grease, dirt, food, and more. The material and construction provides a durable and a long lasting towels that you can use over and over again. The classic design coordinates with most kitchen décor, these dishtowels are a great basic kitchen essential with multiple colors available. With each wash, these towels become more absorbent, helping to clean up even the biggest messes. They’re handy for mopping up in the kitchen or anywhere spills occur.
